specificFindings: You might ask is a possible imagined reader response,not actual user history or proof every reader asked it. Despite marks a concessive relation to the prior chapter without claiming the user completed it.

Would have called diversions is the authors proposed Pascal classification,not a verified verbatim historical comment about these exact modern activities. In other words reformulates the genuine-benefit question rather than answering it.
Nature may have an answer is tentative transition to foraging research,not proof all human decisions match birds or that exploration always beats exploitation.

Great tit Parus major,family Paridae,about five inches and the four named regions are preserved as the books description. Approximate length is not converted to exact centimetres or an age. No new current-distribution survey is claimed.

Large food-availability difference example50percent is linked to about10 hops and staying with the better patch; small10percent difference to over40 hops on average. Counts are hops,not birds,and example percentages are not universal fixed conditions.
Exploited is use of an already identified better resource,not social abuse. Explore-then-exploit is not continuous exploration or avoidance of the better patch.

Computer-generated optimal results and actual bird experimental data are different evidence types. Comparison and near identity do not imply the birds calculated on computers or that simulated records were actual observations.
Leans toward exploration is a tendency in the authors definition of richness,not an absolute ban on exploiting known options. Seem and according to circumstances limit the human analogy.

The fall2019 UVA585-student comparison is not rewritten as random assignment to college year or repeated follow-up of the same students through four years. Preference differences alone do not establish causal within-person development.
Sophomore happy-first/rich-second and senior meaningful-first/happy-close-second are kept distinct from first-year rankings. Close does not supply an unstated exact percentage difference.

Actual Figure4 on page104 was visually inspected:junior richness33.9percent,happiness33.9percent,meaning32.1percent. The prose says equally attractive; the question explicitly asks the prose description and explains comparable attraction does not justify exactly equal percentages or invented33.3percent each. The original English and inherited Chinese wording are unchanged.
Early on and many restrict the exploration preference; subsequent priorities seem to shift. No lifelong all-student trajectory or definite optimality is inferred.

The UVA optimality question remains open and the second question expands to humans in general. Observed preference is distinguished from an optimal decision standard; neither question itself proves optimal or worst behaviour.

They authored refers to cognitive psychologists Peter Todd and Geoffrey Miller,not the preceding student cohort or Kepler. The article title is retained as printed without treating it as a runtime instruction.

Kepler is introduced as a German astronomer and mathematician. First-wife death and limited-mourning explanation remain the books historical narrative,not fresh diagnostic verification or a universal grief rule.

Methodical indicates systematic search and comparison,not proof every step used an optimal probability formula. The narrative sequence is first loss,then search; no unsupported prior remarriage date is invented.
Friends recommend candidate4 for status and dowry; she rejects after waiting. His personal favourite candidate5 is the eventual choice,not proof he simply chose maximum wealth.

Though not wealthiest yet well educated and is thought to have provided retain both concession and attribution. Favourable home conditions do not mean she authored all four works or was the proven sole cause of output.

Probably good sense of probability is an author inference,not a documented37percent calculation by Kepler. The secretary problem is introduced as a named statistical decision problem,not an actual site recruitment or a guarantee for relationships.

Last two evidence quotes are exact target sentences,leaving unassigned interview-task details pending rather than prematurely counting the entire parent as directly questioned. Planned-evidence guard confirms25 added IDs and all published fingerprints retained.

All11 inherited parent English/Chinese pairs were read completely and checked against actual pages103-105,including the cross-page foraging comparison,Figure4 table versus prose,hedges,attribution,conditional history and complete translations.
